author: fdickos
body:
My Minecraft username is fdickos.  I was banned for the use of an inappropriate username.  This ban was a misunderstanding and my username was not meant to be viewed as profanity.  My username in fact is meant to represent my own name/nickname.  I hope you will unban me and I thank you for your time.  I hope I can be back on your server enjoying the PvP minigames that you have all created.  Thank You.



Sincerely, fdickos
